description: This file defines a Java interface named 'Packaging' which declares methods for obtaining packaging details for shipping products, either at the box level or item level, within an e-commerce shipping module.

classes.name: Packaging
classes.description: A Java interface for obtaining shipping packaging details based on products and merchant store information.

methods.name: getBoxPackagesDetails
methods.description: Returns a list of package details for products in box-level packaging, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getItemPackagesDetails
methods.description: Returns a list of package details for individual items, possibly nested or unit packaging, may throw a ServiceException.
